acceptance: Every /docs/dev/ page carries rel=canonical pointing at its /docs/ URL on the site origin, and a site test checks this on built output
Links and other URLs inside /docs/dev/ pages keep their /docs/dev/ prefix
The deploy probe for docs/dev/index.html still passes
context: Created 2026-10-30 when the core item site-release-pinned-docs-20261017 was dropped as superseded by the trunk-only decision; this is the part of it that still applies.
description: /docs/dev/ is a copy of /docs/ made after the build (website/src/lib/dev-docs.ts, mountDevDocs). The copy rewrites every /docs/ URL to /docs/dev/, including the canonical link that website/src/lib/page-meta.ts sets, so each /docs/dev/ page names itself canonical. Both trees render the same develop bundle, so search engines see two copies of every docs page with no preferred one. /docs/dev/ is not in the sitemap and nothing links to it, but it is crawlable. The owner keeps trunk-only documentation (core docs/internal/adr/adr-site-docs-ownership.md: release-pinned documentation is not introduced), so /docs/dev/ stays and each of its pages should name the /docs/ page as canonical.
